original_question:
Design a Verilog module named `bin2gray` that converts a 4-bit binary input into its corresponding 4-bit Gray code output.

The module should have the following interface:
- An input port named `bin`, which is a 4-bit wide wire.
- An output port named `gray`, which is a 4-bit wide register (as it will be assigned within an `always` block).

Implement the standard binary-to-Gray conversion logic. The design should be purely combinational.
